Within the gloomy silt of the Fenlands' most stagnant waters, the blind murrow moves with the certainty of a vicious hunter. With a 
snout covered in barbels, sensitive to the electromagnetic pulses of the heartbeat and movement of nearby fauna, the fi sh can sense prey 
with lethal ease. Rising slowly, its sullen flesh blending with the murk, the lilotoal that sits contently above the water, barely perceiving 
the looming threat below, cannot hop away in time as the lily pad and surrounding water is suddenly sucked into the engulfi ng wide 
maw of the hungry fi sh. Filling its gullet, the large catfi sh sinks down, deep into to the thick mud, digesting and momentarily satisfi ed. 
Class - Actinopterygii • Genus Derived Evolution - Bagarius • Niche - Marine Ambush Carnivore

Siphon Gulp Strength Saving Th row: DC 16, each creature in a 15 ft. 
Cone. Failure: If the creature is Medium or smaller, it is swallowed. 
A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained Conditions, 
has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the 
murrow, and takes 7 (2d6) Acid damage at the start of each of 
the murrow’s turns. If the murrow takes 12 damage or more on 
a single turn from a creature inside it, the murrow must succeed 
on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Th row at the end of that turn or 
regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space 
within 5 ft. of the murrow and unless underwater, has the Prone 
condition. If the murrow dies, any swallowed creatures no longer 
have the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse 
using 5 ft. of movement, exiting Prone. Th e murrow can swallow 
up to one Medium creature or three Small creatures at a time.
Senses Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 12
Challenge 2 (XP 450; PB 2)
Defensive Instinct (1/Day) When suffering a fatal blow, its slow, 
senseless reactions can keep it moving.
Reaction - Trigger: When the murrow reaches 0 hit points. Response 
- Constitution Saving Th row: DC 5 + damage taken from the most 
recent hit, unless it was a critical hit. Success: Th e murrow drops to 
1 Hit Point instead.
Skills Perception +2, Stealth +3
Encountering Often only seen as a shadow beneath the depths 
of stagnate algae-choked waters, the murrow is diffi cult to spot 
in murky waters. With its uncanny ability to detect the heartbeat 
of nearby creatures, the best method to attract the murrow is to 
use live thrashing bait, luring it to the surface and waiting for 
its engulfi ng gulp.
